zones.title: Trigger
zones.body: Every minute. Self-gates: raises incidents only inside an expected session window (a WF-01 manifest exists, now within OPEN-30m..CLOSE+15m). Quiet otherwise.

zones.title: Read status
zones.body: One read-only query builds a status object: latest source_health per source, newest bar age, open jobs and lease, today's manifest, open-incident sigs.

zones.title: Evaluate + apply
zones.body: Thresholds: heartbeat >180s, provider age >120s, http failures, outage, bar gap >180s, overdue lease. Each problem carries a stable sig; new sigs open an incident, cleared sigs resolve. Deduped by open sig, no messaging.

zones.title: Workflow errors
zones.body: Error Trigger. Registered as the errorWorkflow for the intraday collectors; each failed run appends a workflow_error incident with the node and message.
